content.text: Component ID (as printed) | Common Name | Known Aliases | Location | Status | Notes
HPU | Hydraulic Power Unit | Hydraulic Unit; HP unit; Hydraulic Power Pack | Skid A, Bay 2 | Active | Primary hydraulic pressure source for the press circuit.
IV-21 | Isolation Valve 21 | Isolation Valve; IV21 | Hydraulic Module | Active | Must be OPEN prior to HPU startup.
PS-04 | Pressure Sensor 04 | PRESSURE SENSOR 04; P04; PS04 | HPU discharge line | Superseded | Superseded by PS-04A effective software rev 3.2. See ECN-1042.
PS-04A | Pressure Sensor 04A | P04A; PS04A | HPU discharge line | Active | Installed per ECN-1042. Requires controller firmware >= 3.2.
PS-40 | Pressure Sensor 40 | P40; PS40 | Coolant Loop, Skid B | Active | NOT related to the HPU discharge circuit. Do not confuse with PS-04 / PS-04A.
PLC-03 | HCS Controller | Controller; Aegis Controller | Control Cabinet 1 | Active | Supervises startup sequencing, alarms, and interlocks.
A17 | Alarm: Hydraulic Pressure Low | — | N/A (software alarm) | Active | See Alarm Reference AEG-AL-700 for thresholds and required actions.
A18 | Alarm: Hydraulic Pressure High | — | N/A (software alarm) | Active | See Alarm Reference AEG-AL-700.
A19 | Alarm: Pressure Sensor Signal Invalid | — | N/A (software alarm) | Active | See Alarm Reference AEG-AL-700.
TB-7 | Terminal Block 7 | — | Control Cabinet 1 | Active | Wiring reference only, used in AEG-DWG-W03; corresponds to the PS-04A signal loop.
Q1 | Main Disconnect | — | Control Cabinet 1 | Active | 480V incoming disconnect.
T1 | Control Transformer | — | Control Cabinet 1 | Active | 480:120V control power.
